details.effect: [evolve][cost02]: Evolve this follower. [act] Put another Chess follower from your field into its owner's cemetery: Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it 5 damage. For the rest of this turn, this card's [act] abilities except [evolve] can't be activated.

issues: The activated ability is missing the clause 'For the rest of this turn, this card's [act] abilities except [evolve] can't be activated.' Add grantActRestriction with exceptEvolve true and untilEndOfTurn true after dealing 5 damage.

The activated ability is incorrectly limited with oncePerTurn. The source does not say once per turn; it becomes unusable for the rest of the turn only after each activation because of the effect itself. Remove oncePerTurn and encode the printed self-restriction effect instead.
